meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会接入 GitHub:在仓库的 PR 和 issue 评论线程里参与对话,被 @ 到时回复评论,之后的追问也继续回。每个 PR 或 issue 是独立会话,需要一个专门的机器人账号接收 webhook 事件。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 机器人账号时接管,前提是仓库 webhook 已订阅 issue 评论、PR review 评论等事件;机器人自己发的评论会被过滤掉。

say.text: 把这个 GitHub 仓库接到我的 agent 上
say.note: 会先问仓库是私有还是公开,再配置会话

say.text: 为什么我的评论没有触发 agent?
say.note: 会检查 @ 拼写和 webhook 订阅的事件

say.text: webhook 投递显示红色,是什么原因?
say.note: 会按 401 或超时两种情况排查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude joins the comment threads of a GitHub repo's pull requests and issues, replying when it's @-mentioned and on follow-up comments. Each PR or issue gets its own isolated session.
howto.when_en: It takes over when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment, with repo webhooks subscribed to issue comments and pull request review comments.

say_en.text: Connect this GitHub repo to my agent.
say_en.note: Asks if the repo is private or public, then wires it.

say_en.text: Why don't my comments trigger the agent?
say_en.note: Checks the @-mention spelling and webhook events.

say_en.text: Webhook deliveries show red - what's wrong?
